# Workflow

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Design-feedback marketing: white page, Crimson Pro display at weight 300, Inter 14px body, quiet gray 8px buttons, ink paid-plan actions.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (marketing home, features, pricing, contact; login rendered a spinner; no account created). Themes: light.

Public signed-out surfaces of Workflow (workflow.design), captured 2026-11-19. The pages are the marketing home, features, pricing and contact. The app login URL rendered a loading mark and no form. A banner in the marketing DOM says the app is offline for a planned upgrade. No account was created. Themes observed: light only. Widths measured: 1169 in the preview browser, 1440 and 390 in headless Playwright on the same public URLs.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Crimson Pro and Inter are loaded from Webflow's CDN as variable fonts. The tokens name them and fall back to Times New Roman, Arial and sans-serif. They are not shipped in this package.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The preview browser returned "The browser is not producing screenshot frames". Home, pricing and features screenshots were taken later in headless Playwright on the same public URLs, which had already loaded without a Cloudflare challenge. They are full colour. Read colours from the tokens.

The features heading computed at `60.992px` at 1169px. That value is kept. The home heading at the same width is 32px. Dark mode was not present. The OS preferred dark in the preview tab and the page stayed light.

`a.nav--menu.w-button` computed Webflow blue, `rgb(56, 152, 236)`, at height 0. That is the hidden menu button, not a brand colour. Prices on `/pricing` are not tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Set display type in Crimson Pro at weight 300.** Headings on the home and pricing pages are 32px with a 32px line. See [screenshots/home-light-desktop.png](screenshots/home-light-desktop.png).
- **Use the quiet gray for the marketing action.** Try now and Get started are `#f6f6f6` with ink text and an 8px radius. See [components/crops/button-secondary-default.png](components/crops/button-secondary-default.png).
- **Use ink, not a brand blue, for the paid-plan action.** Get started for free on pricing is `#1a1a1a` with `#f6f6f6` text.
- **Keep body copy in Inter at 14px.** The line height is 21px. Muted text is `#1a1a1a` at about 65% opacity.
- **Leave prices out of the system.** The yearly figure on the pricing page is regional.
